page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, utilizing the AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing the instance in the top 25% of its class. Multi-core performance and memory bandwidth metrics fall within the average range, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 43208.77 and large-block uncached read memory bandwidth reaching 83.67 GB/sec. Cryptographic and integer operations are supported by hardware-level instructions, including AES, VAES, and SHA_NI, which contribute to an average Passmark CPU encryption score of 34051.87.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio make this instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local SSD storage. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs reduces overhead for pure processing tasks. This hardware profile is well-suited for workloads such as web serving, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and database operations, as demonstrated by a static web serving throughput of 23.65 GB/sec and an average of 30.6 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks.
